title: observability: token-KV metrics, structured logging, dashboards and alert tuning
author: Priya Nair
description: Add token-level KV cache metrics, structured logging, Grafana dashboards, and alert tuning to improve visibility into per-token cost and latency and KV cache efficiency. This PR implements: 1) Prometheus metric exports in the serving runtime: redwood_kv_cache_hit_total, redwood_kv_cache_miss_total, redwood_token_cost_usd, redwood_token_latency_ms; 2) structured JSON request/response logs with KV key anonymization and sampling controls to limit sensitive data and high-volume log cardinality; 3) Grafana dashboards showing per-model, per-route token cost and latency heatmaps, KV hit/miss ratios, and SLI/SLO panels; 4) updated alerting rules that reduce false positives by using rate()/increase() windows and a simple SLO anomaly detector; 5) a short backfill script for cache histograms and migration notes. Motivation: recent incidents in January showed undetected KV cache regressions that increased token costs ~12%; richer telemetry lets SRE and runtime teams detect regressions earlier and tune batching/caching. This PR includes unit and integration tests, docs updates, and a rollout plan gated by feature flag 'obs.token_kv_v2' with a 10% canary. See Linear ENG-1345 and SRE runbook https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-1345. Checklist: [x] runtime metric exports, [x] logging schema and sampling, [x] dashboards, [x] alert tuning, [x] tests, [x] feature flag + canary, [x] docs. No breaking changes: feature disabled by default.

review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Can we ensure metric cardinality is bounded? model_id and route tags could explode for low-volume customers.
Priya Nair: Added label normalization and a 'model_tier' rollup tag for low-volume models; metrics exporter caps unique labels at 1000 per scrape (configurable).
Sofia Martinez: Alert thresholds look aggressive and produced noise during canary last week; prefer using rate() over 5m and an anomaly detector baseline.
Priya Nair: Updated alert rules to use increase() over 5m and added a simple SLO anomaly detector with a 7d baseline window; also added mute windows for canaries.
Ethan Park: CI failed on lint for structured logger formatting; please run gofmt and fix the import ordering.
Priya Nair: Fixed formatting, added pre-commit step to enforce logger formatting, and re-ran CI.
release_notes: Improved observability for token-level cost/latency and KV cache efficiency: adds new Prometheus metrics, structured logging, Grafana dashboards, tuned alerts, and a controlled rollout behind feature flag 'obs.token_kv_v2'.
notes: Rollout plan: enable flag for internal staging, canary 10% on Dedicated, monitor cost and KV hit SLIs for 48h, then gradual ramp to 100% if no regressions. Backfill script recommended for 7 days of histogram data for retrospective comparison.
related_incidents: INC-2026-01-KVREG: KV cache regression increased token spend by ~12% in Jan; this work is the primary mitigation and visibility improvement.
changelog_short: Add token-level KV metrics, structured logs, dashboards, and tuned alerts
user_impact: None by default; enabled via feature flag. Observability-only change with minimal perf overhead when sampling enabled.
manual_steps_for_ops: To enable: set obs.token_kv_v2=true in feature flags, run backfill script if desired, and unmute alerts after canary policies are in place. See redwood/docs/observability/token_kv.md for runbook.
notes_for_release_engineer: Merge via squash. Ensure grafana/dashboard JSON is imported to prod Grafana with correct datasource mappings and that alerting rules are deployed to alertmanager with mute windows for canaries.
